description: Etat des stations de vélos en libre-service en temps réel is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Etat des stations de vélos en libre-service en temps réel, comprenant notamment le nombre de vélos disponibles, le nombre de places disponibles et leur état de fonctionnement. Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, vélostar, emplacements, arceaux, stations, disponibilité. The portal shows 57 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2014-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
